sql:
/*
================================================================================
项目：蜡笔小新首日在线时长分布对比（繁体 CBT vs 新加坡 Android）
口径：两组均为各自开服首日 new_role cohort；活跃分钟为相邻非 app 事件间隔 0~119 秒累计。
说明：不再使用新加坡 OBT1 整周全量用户，保证与首日付费/留存对比同 cohort。
================================================================================
*/
WITH TC_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Android AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_os' AND tag_value = 'Android'
),
SG_Singapore AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_country' AND tag_value = '新加坡'
),
RawEvents AS (
    SELECT
        '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        v."#event_name" AS event_name,
        v."#event_time" AS event_time
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '新加坡Android' AS cohort_name,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        v."#event_name" AS event_name,
        v."#event_time" AS event_time
    FROM ta.v_event_13 v
    INNER JOIN SG_Android a ON v."#user_id" = a.user_id
    INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON v."#user_id" = s.user_id
    LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_date" = '2026-05-08'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT cohort_name, account_id
    FROM RawEvents
    WHERE event_name = 'new_role'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
CohortEvents AS (
    SELECT r.*
    FROM RawEvents r
    INNER JOIN CohortUsers c
      ON r.cohort_name = c.cohort_name
     AND r.account_id = c.account_id
),
EventGaps AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        account_id,
        DATE_DIFF(
            'second',
            CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP),
            LEAD(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER (
                PARTITION BY cohort_name, account_id ORDER BY event_time
            )
        ) AS next_gap_seconds
    FROM CohortEvents
    WHERE event_name NOT LIKE '%app%'
),
UserDuration AS (
    SELECT
        c.cohort_name,
        c.account_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.next_gap_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 119 THEN g.next_gap_seconds ELSE 0 END), 0) / 60.0 AS active_minutes
    FROM CohortUsers c
    LEFT JOIN EventGaps g
      ON c.cohort_name = g.cohort_name
     AND c.account_id = g.account_id
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
DurationBuckets AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        account_id,
        CASE
            WHEN active_minutes < 5 THEN '01.<5分钟'
            WHEN active_minutes < 15 THEN '02.5-15分钟'
            WHEN active_minutes < 30 THEN '03.15-30分钟'
            WHEN active_minutes < 60 THEN '04.30-60分钟'
            ELSE '05.60分钟以上'
        END AS duration_tier
    FROM UserDuration
)
SELECT
    cohort_name AS "对比组",
    duration_tier AS "在线时长区间",
    COUNT(*) AS "用户数",
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_name), 2) AS "占比(%)"
FROM DurationBuckets
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
